scripts.check: node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),{spawnSync}=require('child_process');const js=(d)=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap((e)=>e.isDirectory()?js(path.join(d,e.name)):e.name.endsWith('.js')?[path.join(d,e.name)]:[]);const todos=[...fs.readdirSync('server').filter((f)=>f.endsWith('.mjs')).map((f)=>path.join('server',f)),...js(path.join('public','js'))];const falhas=todos.filter((f)=>spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'}).status);if(falhas.length){console.error('node --check falhou em: '+falhas.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log(todos.length+' arquivos conferidos com node --check')"
